localChanges: Cities with heavy industry, or large populations once Industrialization, the Automobile, Mass Production and Plastics are known, now pollute the squares around them, and you're told "Pollution near Beijing." A Hydro Plant, Nuclear Plant or Hoover Dam halves a city's pollution from industry, a Recycling Center cuts it to a third, and Mass Transit stops its people polluting (closes #32).
A polluted square yields half its food, shields and trade. Settlers clean it up in 4 turns with the new Clean up pollution order (p).
Nuclear fallout is the same pollution, so it now halves a square's yields too and can be cleaned up.
